title: Existence of Strong Truncated Differentials for bison
summary: Strong differential bounds make strong truncated differentials seem unlikely, but whether bison admits one remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Although bison has strong bounds on differentials, they provide only heuristic evidence that no strong truncated differential exists. Determine whether bison admits a strong truncated differential: either prove that none exists or exhibit one.

scope.domain: Cryptanalysis of the bison block cipher, focusing on strong truncated differentials.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether bison admits a strong truncated differential by proving that none exists or exhibiting one.

citations.label: bison Instantiating the Whitened Swap-Or-Not Construction

progress.summary: The source presents strong differential bounds as heuristic evidence that strong truncated differentials are unlikely. It leaves the question open, requiring either a proof of nonexistence or an exhibited differential.
